ev.q: Notice to Readers Availability of Updated HIV Treatment Guidelines

public_health_question.v: Where can clinicians obtain the updated adult/adolescent and pediatric antiretroviral treatment guidelines for HIV infection?

ev.q: The updates are available from the World-Wide Web site of the HIV/AIDS Treatment Information Service (ATIS)
Availability of Updated HIV Treatment Guidelines
Two HIV-related treatment guidelines have been updated.
prepared by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services and the Henry J. Kaiser Foundation Panel

equity.level_reason: A notice announcing updated treatment guidelines; no social-position dimension is analyzed or framed. Age appears only to define the guideline populations (adults/adolescents vs children).
